authority.executionInterpretation: Final bonus phase starts after Title and its mandatory events. Calculate mastery bonuses there, resolve compatible Enchant and its events, then close main-stat bonus calculation and freeze character before image.

contracts.registration: Record each authorized modifier when earned in its immutable source-keyed ledger; do not add it to any raw/stat/mastery result during the earlier main stages.
contracts.raw: Complete scheduled actual stat/mastery draws and any required Resilient retry at their normal stages. Preserve all immutable results plus retained/copy/Double-Nothing base resolution. Resilient/Lucky Number/Pawn continue reading raw mapped values, never bonuses.
contracts.mastery: At finalization, per-weapon score = retained raw base + distinct matching modifiers. Shared ordinary Power Mastery = retained shared raw + distinct all-owned modifiers. Actual God Authority uses source-bound base9 plus the same shared modifiers. Every numeric score is signed and unbounded; no clamp.
contracts.enchant: Evaluate only in final bonus phase after effective Weapon Mastery calculation. Effective score >=5 (Master), enchantable active weapon and an unused compatible configured slot are all required. Earlier stages retain pending gate status even if raw already >=5 or raw+known bonuses would reach5; do not spin early or permanently skip from raw alone.
contracts.boundary: Only Weapon Mastery bonuses can change this threshold. Strength/other-main-stat bonuses, Power Mastery bonus and Power Tier metadata do not raise Weapon Mastery. Power Mastery never generates Enchant.
contracts.deferred: At Weapon or a later acquisition caller, settle raw mastery then register a stable pending final Enchant gate per active weapon. Return to saved caller without an Enchant child. Empty/no weapon has no phantom pending gate; discarded weapons remain inactive.
contracts.late: Resolve actual Enchant and its approved child events using the normal source ledgers, saved return, raw mastery policies, shared-power reuse and acquisition locks. If these create authorized inventory/modifier changes, refresh effective mastery from the same immutable base and current distinct ledger and examine only unused slots. Newly granted weapons resolve normal raw mastery; first late power may resolve the one shared base if previously empty. Never restart earlier main stages.
contracts.drain: Process to quiescence under the existing declared event activation/depth limits. A changed ledger may be reprojected from base; it must never add the whole bonus again to a previous effective value. Each Enchant slot has one consumed activation key. Missing required catalog/compatible declared profile or exceeded event limit remains explicit needs_configuration; never fake success/freeze with pending events.
contracts.finalStats: After every mandatory Enchant/late event/raw draw/retry/passive Pawn evaluation finishes, process all Lucky Number eligible actual sources, settle its one modifier package, then calculate five main-stat final scores from resolved bases and distinct active bonus/debuff ledgers. Include bonuses earned by actual final-phase Enchant results, such as an already-active Shrek funny-result hook. Fixed projection/recalculation is not an actual spin/hook.
contracts.freeze: Final image/stat card wait until pending events/retries/Enchant gates are resolved or explicitly skipped by final eligibility, modifiers are calculated and final audit succeeds. Do not present a provisional projection as a frozen final score.
contracts.replay: Freeze global policy version, original raw references, modifier-source fingerprint, active inventory snapshot, signed unbounded final-score policy, effective rank used for each gate, pending/consumed slot keys, actual child invocations and saved final-phase cursor. Resume uses existing first/retry/Enchant results; no extra spins, grants or duplicate effects.
contracts.migration: Pre-revision committed journals preserve their frozen early-Enchant/timing policy. No automatic relabeling, new eligibility check, reward migration or Enchant spin on an old finalized character.

finalizationSteps.operation: Complete all prior mandatory Title/late events, raw stat/mastery slots and Resilient retries; keep numeric bonuses pending.
Project active per-weapon and one common power effective rank from retained raw bases and distinct sources without numeric clamps; preserve God instance override.
For each active compatible weapon, effective>=5 and unused slot -> actual Enchant spin/events; otherwise record final skip reason. All child results/reactions complete.

Complete authorized late acquisitions/raw masteries/retries and source hooks. If inventory/modifier fingerprint changed, return to calculate-effective-masteries and check only unused slots, respecting event limits.
Once no mandatory child/gate remains, audit Pawn and Lucky Number, settle Lucky modifier once, sum all five main-stat bonus/debuff ledgers against resolved bases without numeric clamps.
Audit consistent final masteries/Enchant slots/stats/provenance, then freeze and generate image/final card.
